data.name: Tiny Restorations - VR Building
data.detailed_description:
Your grandfather's garage holds a lifetime of unfinished promises. It's time to finish them.

Tiny Restorations is a narrative VR experience set inside a cluttered, memory-filled garage. Your grandfather is moving out next week, and the only person who can help him go is you.

Restore the projects he never got around to — a rocking chair meant for your mom, a red wagon he promised to build before you were born, a dusty convertible waiting thirty years for one last drive. With each completed build, you'll uncover voicemails, photographs, and handwritten notes that piece together a life spent on the road, and a family that deserved more of his time.

RESTORE WHAT WAS LEFT BEHIND Assemble, sand, and repair real objects using intuitive hands-on VR mechanics. Every project tells a story — and some parts have rusted through waiting.

A GARAGE FULL OF SECRETS Search the shelves, clear the clutter, and uncover hidden photographs and forgotten notes. The more you dig, the more you understand.

TOOLS THAT OPEN NEW POSSIBILITIES A rust removal tank, a paint sprayer, a hydraulic jack — each new tool changes what you can do and where you can go.

A STORY TOLD IN SMALL MOMENTS No cutscenes. No exposition dumps. Just voicemails from people who love each other imperfectly, and the objects they left behind.

A 1–3 hour hand-crafted experience.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or Higher
  • Processor: Intel Dual Core
  • Memory: 1024 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD Graphics
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Dolby Surround
  • VR Support: Yes
